label: B25-RX-CPU-OBSERVABILITY-VOLATILE-SOF
title: Generate one volatile SOF from the accepted T-017 fitted database
reads: T-20260920-010 assembler runner/evidence as a template only
scope: Create a never-before-used task-owned byte-identical clone of the accepted T-017 post-STA project, verify source and fitted database identities, run Quartus assembler exactly once, and seal the single volatile catapult_a10.sof with size, SHA-256, Quartus checksum, design hash and JTAG usercode.

validation.freshness: The T-020 remote root must not preexist. Copy only from the T-017 accepted physical root; never import T-007/T-010 databases or SOFs.
validation.immutability: T-017 source pre/post manifest remains identical and the T-020 clone baseline matches it byte-for-byte.
validation.database: The fitted database payload remains unchanged; only the narrowly reviewed assembler report/runlog metadata delta is allowed, with zero removed paths.
validation.assembler: Invoke exactly once: quartus_asm --read_settings_files=on --write_settings_files=off catapult_a10 -c catapult_a10. Require Successful, zero errors and command identity in stdout/report.
validation.artifacts: Exactly one SOF exists; POF/JIC/RBF/JBC/SVF/JAM counts are all zero. Record SOF bytes/hash/checksum/design hash/usercode and fetch the SOF plus reports into the task-local ignored root.
validation.boundary: No synthesis, fitter, STA, source edit, programmer, JTAG, terminal, FPGA configuration, Flash, reset, power or process termination.

acceptance: One content-addressed volatile SOF is produced from the exact accepted T-017 fitted database without changing the source or physical payload and without touching the board.
resource: Every GamePC clone/query/assembler/fetch action must run under resource-lock gamepc. Require no conflicting EDA/programmer/terminal process; never stop an unknown or pre-existing process. Monitor event-driven with waits up to one hour.
forbidden_regions: synthesis, fitter, STA, timing optimization or source/QSF/SDC/RTL/boot modification
T-007/T-010 physical databases, reports or SOFs as evidence or input
quartus_pgm, jtagconfig, nios2-terminal, FPGA configuration, board reset/power or hardware access

dispatch.monitoring: event-driven, up to one-hour waits, no frequent polling

result.assembler: PASS; exact command invoked once, Successful, 0 errors, 0 warnings
result.source_and_database: PASS; source/clone manifest identical, physical database payload changes 0
result.boundary: No synthesis/fitter/STA, programmer, JTAG, terminal, FPGA configuration, Flash, reset or power action
